info.title: Port_Access_Client_Auth_Attribute
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

auth_failure_reason.description: Reason for authentication failure:  `server-timeout`:             authentication server is not reachable.  `supplicant-timeout`:         supplicant is not reachable.  `server-reject`:              authentication server rejected the client.  `no-server`:                  no authentication servers configured.  `attribute-processing-error`: error processing attributes received from                                authentication server.

auth_state.description: State of port access authentication:  `initialized`:       the authentication process for client is started.  `held`:              authentication has failed for the client and reauthentication                        process is yet to begin.  `unauthenticated`:   client to be authenticated.  `authenticating`:    client authentication in-progress.  `authenticated`:     client authentication completed successfully.  `reauthenticating`:  client reauthentication in-progress.  `cached-reauthenticated`:  client remains authenticated due to                             radius server unreachability.

authentication_method.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Client_Auth_Attribute](#/Port_Access_Client_Auth_Attribute)
Authentication method specific port access client attributes.

authenticator_statistics.description: Statistics associated with the Authenticator State Machine. Updated every 5 seconds.

auth_enters_authenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine entered  into AUTHENTICATING state.

auth_enters_cached_reauthenticated.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from REAUTHENTICATING to CACHED-REAUTHENTICATED, as a  result of RADIUS server unreachability.

auth_enters_reauthenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from AUTHENTICATED to REAUTHENTICATING, as a result of  reauthentication timer expiry.

auth_fail_while_authenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from AUTHENTICATING to HELD, as a result of the  authentication failure.

auth_fail_while_reauthenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from REAUTHENTICATING to HELD, as a result of the  authentication failure.

auth_reauths_while_authenticated.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from AUTHENTICATED to REAUTHENTICATING, as a result of a  re-authentication request.

auth_successes_while_authenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from AUTHENTICATING to AUTHENTICATED, as a result of  successful authentication of the client.

auth_successes_while_reauthenticating.description: Total number of times that the state machine transitioned  from REAUTHENTICATING to AUTHENTICATED, as a result of  successful authentication of the client.

auth_timeouts_while_authenticating.description: Total number of times authentication failed when in  AUTHENTICATING state due to authentication server  unreachability.

dot1x_authenticator_statistics.description: Statistics associated with the 802.1X Authenticator State Machine. Updated every 5 seconds.

auth_eap_logoff_while_authenticated.description: Total number of times EAPOL-Logoff message received from the Supplicant in AUTHENTICATED state.

auth_eap_logoff_while_authenticating.description: Total number of times EAPOL-Logoff message received from the Supplicant in AUTHENTICATING state.

auth_eap_starts_while_authenticated.description: Total number of times EAPOL-Start message received from the Supplicant in AUTHENTICATED state.

auth_eap_starts_while_authenticating.description: Total number of times EAPOL-Start message received from the Supplicant in AUTHENTICATING state.

dot1x_eap_method.description: EAP method used for authentication in pass-through mode by the 802.1X authenticator. `MD5`:       MD5 hash function to generate hashed password `TLS`:       Transport Layer Security Protocol `MS-CHAPv2`: Microsoft's Challenge Handshake Authentication              Protocol `PEAP`:      Protected Extensible Authentication Protocol `TTLS`:      Tunneled Transport Layer Security Protocol `GTC`:       Generic Token Card `TNC`:       Trusted Network Connect `SIM`:       Subscriber Identity Module `AKA`:       Authentication and Key Agreement `AKA-Prime`: Authentication and Key Agreement Prime `PAX`:       Password Authenticated eXchange `PSK`:       Pre-Shared key `SAKE`:      Shared-secret Authentication and Key Establishment `FAST`:      Flexible Authentication via Secure Tunneling `IKEv2`:     Internet Key Exchange `GPSK`:      Generalized Pre-Shared Key `TEAP`:      Tunnel-based Extensible Authentication Protocol `UNKNOWN`:   Unsupported EAP method

radius_attributes.description: The RADIUS attributes received for the client.  Outer key: the `attribute_id` is derived from a combination of            RADIUS attribute type and the vendor ID separated by a            `:`.            For standard attribute types, the vendor ID is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`            with type 58, attribute_id will be 58:0.            For vendor specific attributes from Aruba (Vendor-ID            14823) such as `aruba-user-role` and            `aruba-cppm-user-role` the attribute_id will be            26:14823.  Inner key: the `vendor_type_instance` is derived from a            combination of the vendor type associated with a            RADIUS attribute and the nth instance of the            attribute appearing in the same RADIUS message            separated by a `:`.            The value associated with this key is the value            received for that instance of the vendor type.            For standard attributes, the vendor_type is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`,            the first instance of this attribute in a RADIUS            message will have vendor_type_instance as 0:1, the            second instance (if exists) as 0:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-user-role` with            vendor type 1, the first instance of this attribute in            a RADIUS message will have vendor_type_instance as            1:1, the second instance as 1:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-cppm-user-role`            with vendor type 23, the first instance of this            attribute in a RADIUS message will have            vendor_type_instance as 23:1, the second instance as            23:2 and so on.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: Port_Access_Client.mac
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Client](#/Port_Access_Client)
MAC address of the client.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
